record_under_review.evidence_span: VERIRL introduces Veribench-53K, curated from more than 700K Verilog problems with structured prompts, complexity labels, and testbenches. Its reinforcement-learning pipeline uses Trace-back based Rescore to improve sparse/noisy reward feedback and sample-balanced weighting to limit forgetting and overfitting; the abstract reports gains in test pass rate, functional correctness, and compilation robustness and releases the system publicly.
record_under_review.hardware_or_process_assumptions: LLM-based HDL generation evaluated through compilation, simulation, and functional tests; exact model sizes, hardware, and test-suite composition require full-paper verification.
record_under_review.limits: The evidence is an author preprint and public repository; the repository has not independently reproduced the reported gains or verified benchmark splits, leakage controls, reward validity, and hardware cost.
record_under_review.method_or_artifact: Reinforcement-learning framework for Verilog generation with a 53K-example dataset, Trace-back based Rescore, adaptive sample-balanced weighting, and co-evolving policy/reward models.
metrics: 53K curated training/evaluation examples from more than 700K problems
record_under_review.problem: Verilog generation is difficult for language models because of concurrency semantics, rigid syntax, simulation complexity, and sparse or noisy correctness feedback.
record_under_review.title: VERIRL: Boosting the LLM-based Verilog Code Generation via Reinforcement Learning
record_under_review.workload_or_benchmark: Verilog code-generation tasks with diverse testbenches and complexity labels, curated from more than 700K source problems.
